text: Two solutions of a second-order linear homogeneous ODE are linearly independent on an interval precisely when their ___ is nonzero there.
explanation: The Wronskian W(y1,y2) = y1*y2' - y2*y1' is nonzero exactly when the two solutions form a fundamental set. By Abel's identity the Wronskian is either identically zero or never zero on the interval.
